derivation_rule_v2: Stated before any error inspection: subsystems = top-level dirs under server/ ranked by total baseline error count, EXCLUDING governance and mcp (EXP-0011 disjointness); top 2 remaining = S1 (higher), S2; within each, top 3 files by in-subsystem error count desc, tie alphabetical; positions p1..p3 in that order.

amendment_v2.ground: pre-existing owner quarantine of the historical coherence-field source (registry: located, not copied, not wired, no authority). Building EXP-0013 evidence stores and worker tasks from quarantined source would entangle experiment artifacts with it.
amendment_v2.honesty: rule-statement defect disclosed, not a silent swap: the exclusion ground predates the rule statement; the amendment was decided on subsystem IDENTITY only — no error content was examined in making it.
amendment_v2.effect: selection shifted from {emotional-geometry-runtime, deployment} to {deployment, agent}

derivation_rule_v3: AMENDED (disclosed): subsystems as in v2 (deployment=S1, agent=S2; governance/mcp/emotional-geometry-runtime excluded). Within each subsystem: p1 (seed) = highest-error-count file whose code set shares >=1 code with each of two other files; p2/p3 = the top two remaining files by count sharing >=1 code with p1; ties alphabetical.

amendment_v3.finding: The v2 selection was structurally void: S1 seed codes {TS2322,TS2339,TS2345,TS2551,TS2554} shared ZERO codes with S1.p2/p3 (pure TS18047), and S2 seed {TS2305,TS2352,TS2554,TS2740,TS2769} shared zero with S2.p2/p3 {TS2339,TS2345} — the seed-distilled store could never match the measured positions query, so every measured pair would refuse as INVALID_UNINTENDED_EMPTY_TREATMENT at spend time. Found by executing the v3 measured state machine with fake transports (red-team suite), i.e. by the same typed pre-spend gate that EXP-0011 lacked.
amendment_v3.why_this_is_legitimate: The amendment uses ONLY the frozen baseline compile (no outcomes exist anywhere); the seed-coverage constraint is arm-symmetric (both arms share the store); EXP-0011 itself plausibly suffered this defect class at position 2 (only p1 rules existed; code-disjoint p2 => structural zero delivery its selector recorded as skip).
amendment_v3.effect: S1: deployment-router(15) dropped (no overlap with any peer); S1 = deployment-persistence(14) -> cms-content-layer(12) -> rollout-persistence(8), all TS18047. S2: unified-gravito(11) dropped; S2 = mcp/domains/persistence(8) -> mcp/unified-tool-bridge(8) -> mcp/domains/hitl(3). Cross-sequence code overlap is now EMPTY (S1 {TS18047} vs S2 {TS2339,TS2345,TS7053}).

disjointness.disclosure: S2 (agent) errors all fall under server/agent/mcp/ — a distinct directory tree from EXP-0011 server/mcp/ with zero file overlap, satisfying the frozen rule; the thematic resemblance (MCP-related code) is recorded rather than hidden.

treatment_blindness: v2 selection used counts only. The v3 amendment additionally used baseline CODE SETS (still zero outcome knowledge, zero file-content inspection beyond compiler output).
